cues.name: sfx_arena_crowd_bed_calm
cues.what: the murmur: a thousand people talking (27), a small ground's ambience (9), a quieter passage of a full stadium (1)
cues.audition: layer from source 9 (a small ground) may have single close voices (its speech measure is 0.12 to 0.17, the highest of the three); source 1 is the St. Pauli home crowd: the span analyses as diffuse (no steady beat, no tonal peaks, no speech-rate modulation), but a slow sung chant under a roar would not show

cues.name: sfx_arena_crowd_bed_lively
cues.what: the same crowd awake: a loud passage of the general ambience (1) over a mood wave (2)
cues.audition: source 1 and 2 is the St. Pauli home crowd: the span analyses as diffuse (no steady beat, no tonal peaks, no speech-rate modulation), but a slow sung chant under a roar would not show

cues.name: sfx_arena_crowd_bed_roar
cues.what: everybody up: the first seconds of 60,000 yelling (7) with the roar after a goal (8)
cues.audition: source 7 and 8 is the Atletico Mineiro crowd (Portuguese): the span analyses as a diffuse roar, but shouted words inside a roar would not show

cues.name: sfx_arena_crowd_bed_tension
cues.what: a held murmur: the quietest steady passage of the mood waves (2), gently low-passed. It is a hush, not a sung 'oooo'
cues.audition: source 2 is the St. Pauli home crowd: the span analyses as diffuse (no steady beat, no tonal peaks, no speech-rate modulation), but a slow sung chant under a roar would not show

cues.name: sfx_arena_crowd_bed_applause
cues.what: applause and cheering of a large crowd (14); the tonal measure shows whistles from the crowd in it

cues.name: sfx_arena_crowd_erupt
cues.what: a goal's eruption, second take of source 4 (at full size from its first sample)
cues.audition: source 4 is the St. Pauli home crowd: the span analyses as diffuse (no steady beat, no tonal peaks, no speech-rate modulation), but a slow sung chant under a roar would not show

cues.name: sfx_arena_crowd_erupt_2
cues.what: a goal's eruption, first take of source 4 (comes up over about two seconds)
cues.audition: source 4 is the St. Pauli home crowd: the span analyses as diffuse (no steady beat, no tonal peaks, no speech-rate modulation), but a slow sung chant under a roar would not show

cues.name: sfx_arena_crowd_erupt_3
cues.what: a goal at the Mineirao (8): from 25 dB down to full in half a second
cues.audition: source 8 is the Atletico Mineiro crowd (Portuguese): the span analyses as a diffuse roar, but shouted words inside a roar would not show

cues.name: sfx_arena_crowd_cheer
cues.what: a swelling cheer, first take of source 3
cues.audition: source 3 is the St. Pauli home crowd: the span analyses as diffuse (no steady beat, no tonal peaks, no speech-rate modulation), but a slow sung chant under a roar would not show

cues.name: sfx_arena_crowd_cheer_2
cues.what: a swelling cheer, second take of source 3
cues.audition: source 3 is the St. Pauli home crowd: the span analyses as diffuse (no steady beat, no tonal peaks, no speech-rate modulation), but a slow sung chant under a roar would not show

cues.name: sfx_arena_crowd_cheer_3
cues.what: the studio group's recovery into cheers (17, with a little of the bowl) over a stadium cheer (3)
cues.audition: the studio take (17) is a few dozen close voices: single words or one voice may stand out of it

cues.name: sfx_arena_crowd_save
cues.what: the long swelling roar of source 3 (fifth take): a player saves themselves from the fall
cues.audition: source 3 is the St. Pauli home crowd: the span analyses as diffuse (no steady beat, no tonal peaks, no speech-rate modulation), but a slow sung chant under a roar would not show

cues.name: sfx_arena_crowd_ooh
cues.what: a chance missed, the short fifth take of source 5
cues.audition: source 5 is the St. Pauli home crowd: the span analyses as diffuse (no steady beat, no tonal peaks, no speech-rate modulation), but a slow sung chant under a roar would not show

cues.name: sfx_arena_crowd_ooh_2
cues.what: a chance missed, fourth take of source 5
cues.audition: source 5 is the St. Pauli home crowd: the span analyses as diffuse (no steady beat, no tonal peaks, no speech-rate modulation), but a slow sung chant under a roar would not show

cues.name: sfx_arena_crowd_ooh_3
cues.what: a chance missed, first take of source 5, over the 58,241 of France v USA after a foul (26)
cues.audition: source 26 has referee whistles at 29.5 to 30.7 s and 31.5 s (cut round) and a fainter one near 33.75 s, which is inside this span at low level

cues.name: sfx_arena_crowd_aww
cues.what: a near miss in the stadium (5, sixth take) with the studio group's 'awww' (15) in the near rows
cues.audition: the studio take (15) is recorded very quietly (about 24 dB over its own noise): listen for hiss, and for single voices

cues.name: sfx_arena_crowd_aww_2
cues.what: a near miss in the stadium (5, second take, from its reaction) with the studio group's groan (16)
cues.audition: the studio take (16) is a few dozen close voices

cues.name: sfx_arena_crowd_aww_3
cues.what: a near miss in the stadium (5, third take, from its peak) with three of the audience's 'oooh' and 'ahhh' takes (19)
cues.audition: the audience takes (19) are a small group; which are 'oooh' and which 'ahhh' is not known

cues.name: sfx_arena_crowd_gasp
cues.what: the studio group's unison surprise shout (18), five copies at five pitches a few hundredths apart, in the bowl
cues.audition: one 2.5 s take multiplied: it may sound like the same shout five times, or carry a word

cues.name: sfx_arena_crowd_gasp_2
cues.what: the same shout (18), four copies at other pitches and offsets
cues.audition: as sfx_arena_crowd_gasp

cues.name: sfx_arena_crowd_laugh
cues.what: a very large group laughing (21, an old film library transfer) over 300 people laughing on a conductor's cue (22)
cues.audition: source 21 is an old optical transfer and may sound dated; source 22 is a conducted audience

cues.name: sfx_arena_crowd_laugh_2
cues.what: the conducted laugh's opening (22) over the large group (21, a little slower)
cues.audition: as sfx_arena_crowd_laugh

cues.name: sfx_arena_chant_stomp
cues.what: stomp-stomp-CLAP six times: single unison claps cut from source 24, played by 240 copies; a stomp is a clap slowed 2.5 times and low-passed
cues.audition: built, not recorded: the stomps are slowed claps and may not read as feet on a stand

cues.name: sfx_arena_chant_claps
cues.what: clap-clap, clap-clap-clap four times (source 24's claps, 260 copies), answered by a stadium cheer (3)
cues.audition: built, not recorded; source 3 is the St. Pauli home crowd: the span analyses as diffuse (no steady beat, no tonal peaks, no speech-rate modulation), but a slow sung chant under a roar would not show

cues.name: sfx_arena_chant_claps_fast
cues.what: clap-clap in pairs, speeding up over eight seconds (source 24's claps, 260 copies), ending in a stadium cheer (3)
cues.audition: built, not recorded; source 3 is the St. Pauli home crowd: the span analyses as diffuse (no steady beat, no tonal peaks, no speech-rate modulation), but a slow sung chant under a roar would not show

cues.name: sfx_arena_chant_drums
cues.what: supporters' rhythmic clapping and drumming before the goal (11)
cues.audition: source 11 is a German club's supporters: the span is percussive with little energy in the voice band, but a chant sung quietly along with the drum would not show

cues.name: sfx_arena_chant_horns
cues.what: supporters with horns (25): two long blasts with the supporters between them
cues.audition: the analysis cannot tell an air horn from a car horn or a vuvuzela: these are the two strongest steady-pitched blasts (118 to 122 s, 126 to 128 s)

cues.name: sfx_arena_chant_ooh_hey
cues.what: 60,000 holding a yell (6, its held vowel only) cut into a stadium cheer (3, fourth take)
cues.audition: AUDITION FIRST. Source 6 is a Brazilian crowd's held yell before a kick, which is customarily ended with a shouted word; the cut stops at 33.65 s, before the level drops and the shouting after it, and the cheer covers the cut, but only a listener can say that no word is left

to_be_recorded.name: sfx_arena_chant_tumbang_preso
to_be_recorded.rhythm: two beats on TUM-BANG, two on PRE-SO, at about 100 bpm, then clap clap, clap-clap-clap; three times, about 12 s

to_be_recorded.name: sfx_arena_chant_taya
to_be_recorded.rhythm: two even beats, a beat's rest, six calls at about 96 bpm over a bass drum, about 9 s

to_be_recorded.name: sfx_arena_chant_tumba
to_be_recorded.rhythm: two beats, seven calls speeding up from about 90 to 150 bpm, about 8 s
